entry.title: GraphRAG: Unifying Knowledge Graphs and Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Complex Reasoning
entry.summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) significantly improves LLM accuracy by grounding responses in external documents. However, conventional chunk-based retrievers struggle with multi-hop reasoning across interconnected documents. We propose GraphRAG, a novel framework combining hierarchical knowledge graphs with dense vector retrieval. We present an end-to-end pipeline for entity extraction and dynamic graph traversal. Extensive experiments show that GraphRAG outperforms standard vector baselines by 28% on multi-hop question answering benchmarks.
